easyrpg.name: EasyRPG Player
easyrpg.toolchainNotes: Uses $DEVKITPRO/cmake/Switch.cmake (preset switch-release) + liblcf >= 0.8.1 + EGL/glad + libnx audout.

nxjs-mvz.name: nx.js
nxjs-mvz.toolchainNotes: Requires switch-v8 >= 15.0.243-9 (fixes full-JIT GC W^X Data Aborts). Package with NXJS_FAT=1 (--fat) and userAccountSaveDataSize=0.

mkxp-z.name: mkxp-z
mkxp-z.toolchainNotes: Meson >= 1.4.0 cross-compiled with cores/mkxp-z/cross/switch-aarch64.ini, gfx_backend=gles, use_miniffi=false, static Ruby MRI 3.1.
